subject: [PATCH v5 14/19] selftests/mm: run every supported collapse order by default

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged selftest to run all supported collapse orders by default, rather than just one order when specified with the -c option. The test now runs each mTHP case once per supported anon THP order below the PMD, and includes both orders as array indices and shift counts. The patch also updates the usage message to reflect these changes and adds range checking for the -s and -c options.
